{{Quote|You'd be amazed how fast our customer-response times can be.|Gaib|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
'''Gaib & TK-0 Inc.''' was a private technological [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] company, owned and operated by the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Gaib]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[TK-0]]. The pair specialized in the acquisition of difficult to come by information and technology for their clients. Gaib & TK-0 Inc. operated throughout and after the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], during which time several employers hired the company's various services. Among the bounty hunting duo's numerous clients were the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Skirata|Skirata clan]], and even the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Organization==
{{Quote|Teekay-zero. And my esteemed mechanic and agent, Gaib.''"<br />"''Always a pleasure. But remember that without me, he's just fancy scrap.|TK-0 and Gaib|<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
Gaib & TK-0 Inc. was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] organization that was formed by two individuals: a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] by the name of [[Gaib]], and a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known as [[TK-0]],<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> which resembled a taller, [[Armor/Legends|armored]] version of a standard [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="TC" /> Considered "tech-hunters," the company focused on the acquisition of information and technology for its clients,<ref name="CSWE" /> and specialized in locating more obscure data and hard-to-source hardware.<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> TK-0 was looked upon to provide [[Computer/Legends|computing]] power, data correlation, and for his talents in accessing local networks. At the same time, Gaib was responsible for overall logistics, TK-0's necessary maintenance, and for directing the droid's searches.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
{{Quote|The tinnie and his sidekick specialize in stolen industrial data and kit. High-tech bounty hunters.|Mereel Skirata, on Gaib and TK-0|<ref name="TC" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> following the kidnapping of the young [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] from his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|home]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the services of Gaib & TK-0 Inc. were called upon by the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] of Rotta's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. In order to locate the Hutt's missing son, Gaib and TK-0 utilized air traffic control records, [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] relay records, and medical database access records, in order to determine that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|the pilot]] of a [[Trident (starship)/Legends|ship]] leaving Tatooine around the time of the abduction had accessed the [[Galactic All-Species Self-Help Database]], requesting information on Hutt healthcare and sickness. That same [[Starship/Legends|ship]] later landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The two [[Mercenary/Legends|contractors]] reported to Jabba's estate on Tatooine with their findings, leading the Hutt crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]] to dispatch a team of bounty hunters to Teth. Gaib and TK-0 were subsequently [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|paid]] for their services, though Jabba offered the two a substantial retainer's fee should they make themselves available to him whenever he needed, noting that should they decline his offer, the alternative would be [[Death/Legends|death]]. The pair accepted, and while the mercenaries dispatched by Jabba failed to retrieve young Rotta from Teth, the Huttlet was ultimately [[Battle of Teth/Legends|rescued]] and returned to his father by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="TCWn" />

[[File:R2-Q5_Sideshow.png|thumb|left|size=250px|[[TK-0]] resembled an armored [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]]]
A year later, in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Gaib & TK-0 Inc. was contracted by the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] [[Mereel Skirata|N-7]] and [[Ordo Skirata|N-11]]—also known as "Mereel" and "Ordo", respectively—on behalf of the clones' [[Gai bal manda|adoptive]] father, [[Kal Skirata]]. Mereel had originally contacted the bounty hunting duo as a means of acquiring hardware upgrades for Skirata's recently purchased [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]], ''[[Aay'han]]''. He then put the company to work tracking shipments of laboratory equipment being [[Smuggler/Legends|illegally transported]] to circumvent the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate's]] [[Decree E49D139.41|ban]] on commercial [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]], as part of Skirata's search for the rogue [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]. The information and leads gathered by Gaib & TK-0 Inc. led Mereel and Skirata to [[Dorumaa]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Almas]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where they found and captured Ko Sai. The two technological bounty hunters were summarily paid one hundred thousand credits for their equipment and informational services.<ref name="TC" />

Gaib & TK-0 Inc. again found itself in the employ of Kal Skirata and [[Clan Skirata|his clan]] in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], in the [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] following the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Galactic Republic into the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> During the events of the night [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] had been issued by then-[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Clone commando/Legends|commandos]] associated with Clan Skirata had attempted to desert the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] for [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], when [[Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension|unfortunate circumstances]] necessitated that the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] be left behind on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> In payment of a favor owed to Mereel, Gaib secured a contract for service work with the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], during which time he was able to spy on the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], and therein determine the status of both commandos. For additional payment, TK-0 infiltrated the [[501st Legion headquarters]] and modified the [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|helmets]] of both Darman and Niner to allow for secure communication between the two [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperial]] commandos and Clan Skirata's [[Kyrimorut/Legends|base]] of operations on Mandalore.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

When the Skirata clan decided to extract Niner and Darman, Gaib & TK-0 Inc. was called upon to acquire four sets of Imperial [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] to allow the clan's clone members to infiltrate the 501st; Gaib and TK-0 delivering a full ten sets of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armor into the clan's custody, in case their employers should have need of them in the future. Having been awarded an Imperial contract for servicing suit systems, the two tech-hunters found themselves with the ability to mark suits of armor they deemed to be defective to be returned to the manufacturer. The incredibly large scale of Imperial Army operations, however, allowed for a lack of oversight that enabled the pair of bounty hunters to simply keep what suits they marked as defective for later resale. Clan Skirata's plans to rescue their left-behind comrades proved ultimately unsuccessful, although Gaib & TK-0 Inc. was handsomely paid with a substantial stack of [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chips]]. TK-0 also stated that it was billing the Empire two hundred credits for every [[Servodriver/Legends|servodriver]] they needed for their armor servicing contract.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Both Gaib and TK-0 were first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' by author [[Karen Traviss]], the third book in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]].<ref name="TC" /> They were later given a brief role in Traviss' novelization of the [[2008]] film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']],<ref name="TCWn" /> but it was only upon the release of ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' that their tech-hunter company was finally given the name "Gaib & TK-0 Inc." during the third chapter's epigraph.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
